name: Command Palette UI
description: UI sub-spec for the Ctrl+P file search overlay: search input, results list with keyboard navigation, recent files display, and progress indicator.

children: .palette-input: search text input with placeholder 'Search files by name...'
.palette-progress: progress bar (visible during file tree walk)

interactions.behavior: Debounced 150ms search: filters workspace files by name/path substring, shows up to 50 results
Moves selection highlight down in results list
Moves selection highlight up in results list
Confirms current selection: opens file via onSelectFile callback
Updates selection highlight to hovered item
Closes palette (if click target is the overlay itself)

states.name: empty-input
states.description: No search text; shows recent files list with section header 'RECENT FILES'

states.name: loading
states.description: Progress bar visible while loading all workspace files via recursive readDir

states.name: results
states.description: Search results visible with selection highlight

states.name: no-recents
states.description: No recent files and empty input; shows 'No recent files. Start typing to search.'
